findings.summary: Nightly 42596642542's dsl-19 shard failed its baseline on the cli svg-witness e2e test with no mutant applied. M18.10's qualifying nightly needs no failed shard. The record's whole plan for it is 'If it recurs, the next run's artifact holds the output'. But this container cannot download artifacts (the blob host is blocked; I confirmed this), and the job log prints only the failure's first line ('TAP version 13'). So a recurrence yields no more than this run did. The one artifact that holds the output expires on 2026-11-23, and nothing asks for it. Every 288-shard baseline runs this process-lifecycle test, so a rare flake recurs across shards, at about 13 h a nightly.

findings.summary: 9b7dafd counted local timings under 3600 s as meeting M18.10's timing clause, with no allowance for CI being slower. Its slowest, schema-31 at 2455 s, ran 3620 s on CI and was cancelled. e378d7d then measured CI at about 1.5 times local, and applied a 25-minute target, but only to the three shards it re-tested. In 42596642542, five other shards ran 42-46 minutes on CI: core-1 2739 s, format-2 2712 s, format-24 2579 s, format-13 2571 s and core-7 2534 s. That leaves about 25 % headroom, while the runner class alone moved the cold setup 1.5 times (397-621 s). No record names a margin, so the next nightly can be cancelled again on a slow-class runner.

findings.summary: Most of the new direct tests check behaviour. They check bounds at limit and limit+1, refusal classes, required fields one by one, and inclusive budgets. One exception is light.test.ts, which restates every token value of LIGHT_THEME in full, as its own comment says: 'This file pins all of them, written out in full'. That kills every literal mutant by construction. It checks no behaviour beyond validateTheme, and any deliberate palette change must edit both files.
findings.evidence: light.test.ts:5-7 and its toStrictEqual blocks for color, font, space, radius, stroke, shadow and motion. svg-artwork-data.test.ts, by contrast, asserts maxChars and maxChars+1, and maxDepth and maxDepth+1. binding.test.ts drops each required key in turn.
findings.failure_scenario: A designer retunes accent-3. The theme test fails as a change detector, not as a defect, and the fix is to copy the new value into the test. Over time this teaches that mutation-driven tests are edited along with the source.
